companyFieldUpdates.name: Lightpath
companyFieldUpdates.description: Lightpath owns, builds, and operates metro and regional fiber networks serving enterprise, hyperscale, data-center, wireless, carrier, government, and institutional customers. The asset-heavy platform provides Internet, Ethernet, transport, wavelengths, private networks, dark fiber, voice, and managed connectivity. As of July 2026, Lightpath reported more than 12,100 route miles, over 18,000 service locations, more than 190 on-net data centers, eight cable landing stations, and operations across 11 metro markets. Optimum Communications retains 50.01% controlling common equity, while Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners holds 49.99% through NHIP III Lantern Holding LLC; no later common-equity transfer was identified.
